name: triage
on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  issue_comment:

permissions:
  issues: write

jobs:
  label:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      TITLE: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}
    steps:
      - name: Echo the title (unsafe)
        run: echo "${{ github.event.issue.title }}"
      - name: Multi-line script
        run: |
          echo "Checking"
          # a comment ${{ github.event.issue.body }}

          echo "${{github.event.comment.body}}"
          uses: actions/fake@v1
      - name: Safe, through env
        env:
          BODY: ${{ github.event.issue.body }}
          HEAD: ${{ github.head_ref }}
        run: echo "$BODY"
      - uses: actions/github-script@60a0d83039c74a4aee543508d2ffcb1c3799cdea # v7.0.1
        with:
          script: |
            const title = "${{ github.event.issue.title }}";
            core.info(`${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}`)
      - name: Not a script key
        with:
          title: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}
      - run: echo ${{ github.event.commits[0].message }} ${{ github.event.pages[1].page_name }}
      - run: echo "${{ github.event.head_commit.author.email }}" "${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch }}"
      - run: echo "${{ github.event.issue.number }}" "${{ github.event.discussion.title}}"
